about_short_description.short_description: Alpha Research is a marketing agency that provides consulting, social, and market research services.

product.name: Quantitative Research Services
product.description: Research methods that use statistical data to measure characteristics such as awareness, satisfaction, loyalty, and impact for policies or businesses.

product.name: Qualitative Research Services
product.description: Research methods focused on understanding motivations, emotions, and reasons behind behaviors without relying on numerical data.

product.name: Consulting Services
product.description: Advisory services that help clients select appropriate research methods and interpret findings for informed decision-making.

product.name: Comparative Economic Indices Product
product.description: A series of indices measuring economic conditions and trends across countries, sectors, and topics for decision-making purposes.
